payload.summary: tests/guard-push.test.ts in-flight CI guard assertion fails on main (pre-existing)
payload.detail: npm run test on a clean origin/main checkout (HEAD a341832) fails one assertion: 'in-flight CI push guard (#HSSHRG) > inFlightCiGuard formats actionable blocked message with PR and run details' at tests/guard-push.test.ts:468 expects result.ok to be false and gets true. Confirmed pre-existing by stashing an unrelated working tree and re-running against the same HEAD, so it is not caused by the 2026-08-20 cleanup change. Everything else passes: 7592 passed, 4 skipped, 693 files. Next step: work out whether the guard's in-flight detection regressed or the fixture drifted, since a guard that returns ok=true on an in-flight run would let a push through that it exists to block.
